text:
Chinese panellists and experts at the Xiangshan Forum have warned against Japan’s remilitarisation amid reports that Tokyo is considering raising its midterm defence spending to 3.5 per cent of GDP.
Japan might raise its midterm budget to 3-3.5 per cent of the country’s gross domestic product in line with Nato and other US allies, Bloomberg reported earlier
text_zh:
在香山论坛上，中国专家和与会者警告反对日本重新军事化，此前有报道称东京正考虑将中期国防开支提高至GDP的3.5%。
彭博社此前报道称，日本可能将其中期预算提高至该国国内生产总值的3%至3.5%，与北约和其他美国盟友保持一致。
